Hi Olga,

We're compiling the SIG/CAIQ packet for our procurement review and need a vulnerability management evidence bundle from Redwood covering the last 12 months (2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30). Specifically we need:

- Scan cadence (external unauthenticated, internal authenticated, image/container scans, CI scanning frequency).
- The documented remediation SLAs you operate to by severity and an attestation that these SLAs were met for all critical CVEs in the period (or an explanation of any exceptions).
- A redacted sample authenticated scan report and the policy that governs scanning/remediation.
- Where we should upload these documents (secure link or portal).

Can you send these by EOD Friday 7/2? If you need a short extension let me know and we can try to accommodate.

Thanks,
Edgar Ramos
Head of Information Security
Acme Corporation

Edgar,

Thanks for the clear list — attaching a small evidence packet and the signed attestation. Quick summary below; attachments are linked at the end and I've uploaded the same bundle to the Drive folder (link included).

Scan cadence (summary):
- External unauthenticated perimeter scans: weekly (automated, CentralScan).
- Internal authenticated dynamic scans: daily for production-facing services; targeted hourly checks for services with frequent releases.
- Container/image scanning: every image build in CI (Snyk/Clair); policy blocks images with critical findings in pipeline.
- Host/infra authenticated scans: full authenticated sweep monthly; incremental scans nightly for new/changed assets.
- Pen tests: vendor-led annual penetration test (last completed 2026-03).

Remediation SLAs (we hold to severity-driven targets):
- Critical: remediation or compensating control implemented within 72 hours of triage and validation.
- High: remediation within 7 calendar days.
- Medium: remediation within 30 calendar days.
- Low: remediation within 90 calendar days or tracked backlog.

Attestation note: the attached PDF (cve_remediation_attestation_2026-06-30.pdf) is signed by our Head of Security and affirms that, for the period 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30, Redwood remediated or implemented compensating controls for all CVEs classified as Critical within our Critical SLA window. For High severity CVEs we remediated the majority within SLA; any exceptions are enumerated in the attestation and include compensating actions and timelines.

Sample report & policy: I attached a redacted authenticated scan sample (redwood_vm_scan_cadence.xlsx) and our scan policy/process (scan_policy_and_process.md). The scan sample has hostnames redacted and shows severity classification, ticket link, and remediation status.

Upload: I uploaded the bundle to a shared Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cRedwood_VM_Evidence — you should have access. If you'd prefer a DocuSign or portal upload, we can send a signed PDF via your portal link.

If you want a short call to walk through the attestation details, loop in a time and I'll get engineering on the line.

Attachments:
- redwood_vm_scan_cadence.xlsx (XLSX)
- cve_remediation_attestation_2026-06-30.pdf (PDF)
- scan_policy_and_process.md (MD)

Best,
Olga Petrov
